text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One of its main tasks is text understanding, where machines analyze written words to grasp their meaning, much like a reader does. This technology is also behind online translation tools, allowing people to instantly convert sentences between different languages. Another common application is sentiment analysis, which businesses use to determine whether customer reviews are positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, NLP powers chatbots that provide customer support on websites. These programs can respond to simple questions, making interactions faster and more convenient for users every day.
